trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.summary: The platinum itself: it unlocks on its own the moment the other 54 trophies are all earned, so the whole guide below is really the guide to this one trophy.

steps.text: Earn the other 54 trophies; the platinum then unlocks automatically — there is nothing separate to do for it.
Budget roughly 200 hours for the full run, most of it inside the 100% checklist behind A Long Road.
Everything is single-player: no online or DLC trophies, no difficulty settings and no mission gold medals to worry about.
Never use cheats on your trophy save — entering a cheat disables trophies and saving.
Keep manual saves at the start and end of each chapter, because there is no mission replay to fall back on.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.summary: The big one: finish the game's 100% Completion checklist. It looks enormous but the thresholds are forgiving — closer to 60% of everything the game contains.

steps.text: Finish the story first: the checklist only appears afterwards, under Progress > Stats > 100% Completion.
Progress made during the story already counts toward the checklist, so nothing you did early is wasted.
Nothing on the checklist is missable — everything on it can still be done in free roam after the credits.
The thresholds are lenient, closer to 60% true completion: the majority of side quests and several collectible types are not required at all.
Required in full: all robberies (including the 8 bank vaults and the 39 gang operations), underwater discoveries, every Shooting Range gold medal, all drone races and Bret's 15 Target Decks.
Only a share of the rest is needed: 100 optional missions, 200 of 277 vehicle scans, 100 of 255 animals studied, 15 of 18 meditations, 70 of 80 challenges, 300 stunts and 100 WAiNK scans.
Guides rank this the hardest trophy on the list and the main time sink of the platinum — plan the run around it.

trophies.guide: The big one: finish the game's 100% Completion checklist. It looks enormous but the thresholds are forgiving — closer to 60% of everything the game contains. Steps: 1) Finish the story first; the checklist appears afterwards under Progress > Stats > 100% Completion. 2) Progress made during the story already counts. 3) Nothing on the checklist is missable. 4) Thresholds are lenient: most side quests and several collectible types are not required. 5) Required in full: all robberies (8 bank vaults, 39 gang operations), underwater discoveries, every Shooting Range gold, all drone races and Bret's 15 Target Decks. 6) Only shares of the rest: 100 optional missions, 200 of 277 vehicle scans, 100 of 255 animals, 15 of 18 meditations, 70 of 80 challenges, 300 stunts, 100 WAiNK scans. 7) It is ranked the hardest trophy and the main time sink of the platinum.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.summary: Complete any 250 of the game's 397 stunts, in any mix of jumps, bridge flights, knife flights and base jumps.

steps.text: Complete any 250 stunts; the 397 total splits into 130 stunt jumps, 202 under-the-bridge flights, 40 knife flights and 25 base jumps.
Mix categories freely — under-the-bridge flights are the quickest kind to rack up.
Track progress by region under Progress > Activities > Stunts, and find the named stunt spots under Map > Exploration > Stunt Spots.
Performing a stunt once completes it; the extra challenge attached to some stunts is not required for the count.
Keep going afterwards if you are chasing 100%: the checklist asks for 300 stunts.

trophies.guide: Complete any 250 of the game's 397 stunts, in any mix of jumps, bridge flights, knife flights and base jumps. Steps: 1) Any 250 count; the 397 split into 130 stunt jumps, 202 under-the-bridge flights, 40 knife flights and 25 base jumps. 2) Under-the-bridge flights are the quickest to rack up. 3) Track progress under Progress > Activities > Stunts and find named spots under Map > Exploration > Stunt Spots. 4) Performing a stunt once completes it; attached challenges are not required. 5) The 100% checklist asks for 300, so keep going.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.summary: Sample every one of the game's nine activity types at least once — a trophy most players finish without trying.

steps.text: Try each of the 9 activity types at least once: fishing, hunting, golf, a shooting range, pool, basketball (sink one basket), an arcade game, winning a race and performing a stunt.
Check what you have already done under Touch Pad > Progress > Activities — scrolling over an activity shows how many you have done.
Most types are introduced by the story itself, and the rest get marked as you unfog the map; filter the map for Activities (the blue dumbbell icon).
Double up your effort: the race win and the stunt on this list are the same activities that feed Earn Cash, Not Kudos and Cunning Stunts, so those counters move at the same time.
You will almost certainly complete this by accident while working on the other trophies and the 100% checklist.

trophies.guide: Sample every one of the game's nine activity types at least once — a trophy most players finish without trying. Steps: 1) Try all 9 types: fishing, hunting, golf, shooting range, pool, basketball, an arcade game, winning a race and a stunt. 2) Check your progress under Touch Pad > Progress > Activities. 3) Most types are introduced by the story; the rest appear as you unfog the map (filter for Activities, the blue dumbbell icon). 4) The race win and the stunt also feed Earn Cash, Not Kudos and Cunning Stunts, so those counters move at the same time. 5) It usually completes by accident during the rest of the run.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.summary: Gold-medal every Shooting Range challenge in Leonida — all 42 of them.

steps.text: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges.
Find ranges and track your medals under Touch Pad > Activities > Shooting Ranges; some challenges stay locked until you meet conditions shown on the map.

One honest disagreement in the sources: PowerPyx and GTA-Zone count 42 golds spread across 12 ranges, while Push Square and OutputLag describe two range locations (Rodgers Ranch in Port Gellhorn and Griffin in Balsero) hosting the challenges between them. The 42 golds are agreed by all four.
Ranges also raise your Focus level, which pays off later for Gunslinger.

trophies.guide: Gold-medal every Shooting Range challenge in Leonida — all 42 of them. Steps: 1) Earn gold in all 42 challenges. 2) Find ranges and track medals under Touch Pad > Activities > Shooting Ranges; some challenges unlock as you meet conditions shown on the map. 3) Sources disagree on the layout (12 ranges per PowerPyx and GTA-Zone; two range locations per Push Square and OutputLag) but agree on 42 golds. 4) Ranges raise your Focus level, which helps Gunslinger later.
trophies.disagree: How the 42 challenges are housed: 12 ranges [1][6] versus two range locations [8][3]. The target — 42 gold medals — is the same in every source.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.summary: Win a Top Fun drone race at each of the 14 locations scattered around Leonida.

steps.text: Win a Top Fun drone race at each of the 14 locations; one win per location is enough for the trophy.
There are 42 drone races across those locations and the 100% checklist wants all 42, so finish each location while you are there.
Some locations charge an entry fee, so arrive with cash in hand.
See the locations you have discovered under Touch Pad > Activities > Drones > Top Fun Drones.

trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at each of the 14 locations scattered around Leonida. Steps: 1) One win at each of the 14 locations earns the trophy. 2) There are 42 races in total and 100% wants all 42, so finish each location while you are there. 3) Some locations charge an entry fee. 4) Track locations under Touch Pad > Activities > Drones > Top Fun Drones.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.summary: Win 20 different races — repeat wins on the same course do not count.

steps.text: Win 20 different races; winning the same race again does not add to the count.
There are 40 unique race locations to choose from, so you only need half of them.
Keep track of them under Touch Pad > Activities > Racing.
Most locations let you hire a car; if you bring your own, watch its Rating, which improves with upgrades from Mod Shops.

trophies.guide: Win 20 different races — repeat wins on the same course do not count. Steps: 1) Win 20 different races. 2) There are 40 unique race locations to choose from. 3) Track them under Touch Pad > Activities > Racing. 4) Most locations let you hire a car; your own car's Rating improves with Mod Shop upgrades.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.summary: Beat your friend Cal at his own game: a fishing challenge off Key Lento. The most-earned optional trophy of launch week, per the live rarity.

steps.text: Meet Cal in the Chapter 1 mission Feng Shui.
Some time afterwards Cal texts you and marks a fishing location west of Key Lento with a purple icon on the map.
Push Square pins down his request: catch a Parrotfish over 2 kg in the marked area, using a boat with a fishing rod — plenty of boats nearby can be borrowed if you have none.
Play through his fishing quest and beat Cal in the challenge to unlock the trophy.

trophies.guide: Beat your friend Cal at his own game: a fishing challenge off Key Lento. Steps: 1) Meet Cal in the Chapter 1 mission Feng Shui. 2) He texts you and marks a fishing spot west of Key Lento with a purple icon. 3) His request is a Parrotfish over 2 kg, caught from a boat with a fishing rod. 4) Beat Cal in his fishing challenge to unlock the trophy.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.summary: Finish one of the four in-game arcade games, start to end — three of them are on the TV at home.

steps.text: There are four arcade games (called Video Games in-game): Tenebrae Lux, Street Trash III, Time Jackers Rewind and Bang For Your Buck; finish any one of them.
The first three are playable on the TV at home by interacting with the controllers, already during Chapter 1; the fourth is on arcade machines around the world.
Completing a game means finishing all of its levels at least once — you do not need to beat its challenges.

trophies.guide: Finish one of the four in-game arcade games, start to end — three of them are on the TV at home. Steps: 1) Pick any of Tenebrae Lux, Street Trash III, Time Jackers Rewind or Bang For Your Buck. 2) The first three are on the TV at home from Chapter 1; the fourth is on arcade machines. 3) Finishing all of a game's levels once completes it; its challenges are not required.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.summary: Finish Lucia's five-quest storyline for Andy, the Cellerica wellness recruiter in Belville.

steps.text: Andy's questline is exclusive to Lucia and is marked automatically in Chapter 3, when Andy calls her and texts her home address in Belville.
Work through all five quests in order: Climbing the Cellerichain (Parts 1–3), Pay the Cellerica Fee, Peach! (the Cellerica initiation), Read the Label and Puff Puff Pass.
The last quest, Puff Puff Pass, is the one that awards the trophy.
All of Andy's quests remain available after the story, so the line cannot be missed.

trophies.guide: Finish Lucia's five-quest storyline for Andy, the Cellerica wellness recruiter in Belville. Steps: 1) The line is Lucia-only and starts in Chapter 3, when Andy calls and texts her Belville address. 2) Complete all five quests: Climbing the Cellerichain, Pay the Cellerica Fee, Peach!, Read the Label and Puff Puff Pass. 3) Puff Puff Pass awards the trophy. 4) The quests remain available after the story.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.summary: Finish Kenton's treasure-diving questline: seven shipwrecks' worth of sunken loot hauled up around Key Lento.

steps.text: Kenton's line is marked automatically in Chapter 1; after Island Dreams he calls you and appears as the green KR icon in Key Lento.
Dive his treasure quests: he marks purple treasure chest icons on the map, and you dig the treasure out of the ocean floor with the metal detector.
Clear 7 shipwrecks in total, handing each set back to Kenton; track the line under Progress > Collections > Kenton's Treasures.
Kenton goes quiet after Chapter 1 but texts Jason again during Chapters 2–3, so the line is not missable even if you leave it.
Push Square names the finale: the last mission is called Maritime Disputes.

trophies.guide: Finish Kenton's treasure-diving questline: seven shipwrecks' worth of sunken loot hauled up around Key Lento. Steps: 1) The line starts in Chapter 1; Kenton is the green KR icon in Key Lento. 2) Dive the purple chest markers and dig treasure up with the metal detector. 3) Clear 7 shipwrecks; track it under Progress > Collections > Kenton's Treasures. 4) Kenton returns in Chapters 2–3, so it is not missable. 5) The final mission is Maritime Disputes.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.summary: Finish Billy's five jobs out of the Thrillbilly Mudclub in Kelly County.

steps.text: Billy's questline is marked automatically after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, at the Thrillbilly Mudclub in Kelly County.
Complete all five of his quests: Thrillbillies, Twist Wrist Smash Grab, Mall Rats, The Impaler and Hometown Heroes.
The fifth quest, Hometown Heroes, is the one that unlocks the trophy.
His quests stay available after the story.

trophies.guide: Finish Billy's five jobs out of the Thrillbilly Mudclub in Kelly County. Steps: 1) The line opens after Chapter 2's Coffee Break at the Thrillbilly Mudclub. 2) Complete Thrillbillies, Twist Wrist Smash Grab, Mall Rats, The Impaler and Hometown Heroes. 3) Hometown Heroes unlocks the trophy. 4) The quests stay available after the story.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.summary: Finish eight full mission strands for the strangers you meet in the open world — but only certain questlines count as strangers.

steps.text: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers found in the open world across Leonida.
Only certain questlines count: Kirk, Kyle, Yago and Pilot Pete are confirmed to count, while the lines of Moses, Tyrone, Yasmani, Andy, Billy and Eddie do not count as strangers toward this trophy.
Check the trophy's own progress counter in your trophy list after each strand you finish, because the remaining qualifying strands are still being confirmed.
Strangers are not needed for 100% completion, and all of them remain available in free roam after the story.

trophies.guide: Finish eight full mission strands for the strangers you meet in the open world — but only certain questlines count as strangers. Steps: 1) Complete 8 stranger mission strands. 2) Kirk, Kyle, Yago and Pilot Pete count; Moses, Tyrone, Yasmani, Andy, Billy and Eddie do not. 3) Watch the trophy's progress counter after each strand, as more qualifying strands are still being confirmed. 4) Strangers are not needed for 100% and remain available after the story.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.summary: Fill Randy's Wish List: sixteen high-end sports cars stolen to order and delivered to his garage in west Vice City.

steps.text: Randy's Wish List opens after the Chapter 3 mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS, which also hands you the Key Cloner; the first car, a Zorrusso, is delivered during that mission itself.
Deliver the 16 sports cars on his list to his garage in the west of Vice City, marked with the green RK icon.
Scan high-end cars with the WAiNK app to see whether one is on the list; hotel driveways around Vice Beach and Ocean Beach are the best places to look.
Cars delivered in good condition pay more, and finishing the cars he marks for you makes him mark new locations on the map.
Track the list itself under Map > Robberies > Randy's Wish List.

trophies.guide: Fill Randy's Wish List: sixteen high-end sports cars stolen to order and delivered to his garage in west Vice City. Steps: 1) The list opens after Chapter 3's Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS, which also gives you the Key Cloner. 2) Deliver the 16 listed cars to his garage (green RK icon). 3) Scan cars with WAiNK to check the list; hotel driveways at Vice Beach and Ocean Beach are prime hunting grounds. 4) Good-condition deliveries pay more. 5) Track the list under Map > Robberies > Randy's Wish List.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.summary: Finish Tyrone's war on the Kitty Litter synthetic labs across Vice City — a Jason-only questline.

steps.text: Tyrone's questline is Jason-only and is marked automatically after the Chapter 3 mission Here, Kitty Kitty.
Destroy the synthetic labs marked with purple icons around Vice City (the Take Out Kitty Litter quest).
Once enough labs are destroyed, Tyrone offers his second quest, Spin On This (Shut Down the Labs), and finishing it unlocks the trophy.
The whole line is still available after the story.

trophies.guide: Finish Tyrone's war on the Kitty Litter synthetic labs across Vice City — a Jason-only questline. Steps: 1) The line is Jason-only and opens after Chapter 3's Here, Kitty Kitty. 2) Destroy the synthetic labs marked in purple (Take Out Kitty Litter). 3) His follow-up quest, Spin On This (Shut Down the Labs), unlocks the trophy. 4) The line remains available after the story.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.summary: Meditate at all 18 meditation spots across Leonida — and the one trophy on the whole list you can genuinely lock yourself out of, thanks to a Chapter 1 balcony.

steps.text: Meditate at all 18 meditation spots, spread across 10 locations in Leonida.

Do the Chapter 1 spot first: on a morning after Down to Earth, Lucia talks about meditating in the kitchen at Jason's house and walks out to the balcony — follow her, talk to her there and choose Accept.
Meditating at a spot with both Jason and Lucia counts as +2 toward the counter, so bring your partner to every spot.
The final meditation needs both characters playable together, which only opens after Chapter 2's Coffee Break.
A meditation only registers once the closing zen animation has fully played — do not walk away early.
Track progress under Progress > Collections > Exploration > Meditations, and find discovered spots on the map under Exploration > Meditate Around Leonida.

trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 meditation spots across Leonida — and the one trophy on the whole list you can genuinely lock yourself out of, thanks to a Chapter 1 balcony. Steps: 1) Meditate at all 18 spots across 10 locations. 2) Do the Chapter 1 spot first: after Down to Earth, follow Lucia from the kitchen at Jason's house to the balcony and choose Accept. 3) Meditating with both characters counts +2, so bring your partner. 4) The final spot needs both characters together, unlocked after Chapter 2's Coffee Break. 5) A meditation registers only once the closing zen animation has played. 6) Track progress under Progress > Collections > Exploration > Meditations.
trophies.missableNote: POSSIBLY MISSABLE — the only one on the list. The balcony meditation at Jason's house exists only during Chapter 1 and is permanently unavailable afterwards, and there is no mission replay. Whether the 18-spot count requires that spot is unconfirmed: PowerPyx is unsure [1]; OutputLag states that it counts [3]. Do it in Chapter 1 and keep a Chapter 1 save until the trophy pops.
trophies.disagree: Does the house balcony meditation count toward the 18? PowerPyx: it raises the counter but is not marked as a Meditation Spot, so it is unclear if it is required [1]. OutputLag: it counts toward the trophy [3]. We show both — and say do it anyway.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.summary: Work Bret Vogel's hunting Target Decks as Jason until the unique animal he is after is in the bag.

steps.text: Bret's questline starts after Chapter 2's Coffee Break: he texts Jason and marks his first quest, Veteran Hunted, in Lummox County. Lucia cannot receive the message — the line is Jason-only.
His first quest gives you the unique hunting rifle Killtelligence SM-69, retrievable afterwards from any weapon locker at Ammu-Nation.
Hunt the animals he requests at the hunting spots he marks with purple icons, and bring them back to Bret as Jason.
A clean one-shot kill leaves the animal pristine and pays more, but it is not required for the questline.
Which single animal triggers the trophy is still unconfirmed; all 15 of Bret's Target Decks are required for 100% anyway, so the trophy should arrive along the way.

trophies.guide: Work Bret Vogel's hunting Target Decks as Jason until the unique animal he is after is in the bag. Steps: 1) The line starts after Chapter 2's Coffee Break with Bret's text to Jason (Veteran Hunted, Lummox County); it is Jason-only. 2) His first quest gives you the Killtelligence SM-69 rifle, retrievable from any Ammu-Nation weapon locker. 3) Hunt the animals he marks and bring them back as Jason. 4) Clean one-shot kills pay more but are not required. 5) The exact trigger animal is unconfirmed; all 15 Target Decks are needed for 100% anyway.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.summary: Complete any three full sets of the collectible cards hidden around Leonida.

steps.text: Complete any 3 full Collectible Card sets — for the trophy you do not need all of them.
There are 18 card sets in the game in total.
Track how close each set is under Touch Pad > Progress > Collections > Collectible Cards.
Cards you have collected can be sold at Pawn Shops and still count toward your progress.
Going for 100%? The checklist needs 15 sets, so this trophy unlocks on the way there.

trophies.guide: Complete any three full sets of the collectible cards hidden around Leonida. Steps: 1) Finish any 3 full sets. 2) There are 18 sets in total. 3) Track each set under Touch Pad > Progress > Collections > Collectible Cards. 4) Collected cards can be sold at Pawn Shops and still count. 5) The 100% checklist needs 15 sets, so this comes on the way.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.summary: Scan 100 of the WAiNK landmarks, curiosities, sculptures and tags with the phone app.

steps.text: WAiNK is the app on Jason and Lucia's phones: hold Up to bring it up, look at a scannable object and hold R1 to scan it.
Any 100 scans count, drawn from 31 Landmarks, 35 Curiosities, 23 Sculptures and the No Flusher tags — there are more than 100 in the game.
Check your running total under Touch Pad > Progress > Collections > WAiNK Locations.
The same app scans vehicles for Whip It Good and checks Randy's Wish List, so scan everything new you pass and several grinds advance at once.

trophies.guide: Scan 100 of the WAiNK landmarks, curiosities, sculptures and tags with the phone app. Steps: 1) Hold Up for the WAiNK app, look at an object and hold R1 to scan. 2) Any 100 count, from 31 Landmarks, 35 Curiosities, 23 Sculptures and the No Flusher tags. 3) Track the total under Touch Pad > Progress > Collections > WAiNK Locations. 4) The same app scans vehicles, so scan everything new you pass.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.summary: Complete 50 of the game's 80 Challenges — most of them tick themselves off while you play everything else.

steps.text: Complete 50 of the 80 Challenges in the game.
View and track them under Progress > Challenges; a finished challenge shows a tick when you scroll over it.
Leave this late: a lot of challenges complete naturally while you work on other trophies, then you can pick the easiest ones still open.
The 100% checklist needs 70 of the 80, so this trophy unlocks automatically on the way there.

trophies.guide: Complete 50 of the game's 80 Challenges — most of them tick themselves off while you play everything else. Steps: 1) Complete 50 of 80 Challenges. 2) Track them under Progress > Challenges. 3) Leave it late; many complete naturally, then pick the easiest remaining. 4) The 100% checklist needs 70 of 80, so it unlocks on the way.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.summary: With your partner beside you, earn a 4-star Wanted Level and then get clean away from the heat.

steps.text: You need both characters together: free-roaming as a pair unlocks after Chapter 2's Coffee Break, and you call your partner by holding Right and pressing Triangle.
Cause enough carnage to reach a 4-star Wanted Level with your partner beside you.
Escape until you are fully out of the red heat zone — leaving the flashing blue/red search area alone is not enough, and the trophy pops only once the heat is gone.
The easiest escape route is the train tunnel north of Ambrosia in Kelly County: police struggle to follow on the tracks and the helicopter cannot see you.
Bank vault robberies always trigger 4 stars with your partner along, so this often unlocks on its own during Maximum Withdrawal.

trophies.guide: With your partner beside you, earn a 4-star Wanted Level and then get clean away from the heat. Steps: 1) Pair up after Chapter 2's Coffee Break (call your partner with Right + Triangle). 2) Reach a 4-star Wanted Level together. 3) Escape fully out of the red heat zone — leaving the search area alone is not enough. 4) The train tunnel north of Ambrosia in Kelly County is the easiest escape. 5) Bank vault robberies trigger 4 stars anyway, so it often unlocks during Maximum Withdrawal.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.summary: Chain three shop robberies with your partner while the police chase never lets up.

steps.text: A partner is required: start after Chapter 2's Coffee Break, when you can switch between both characters, and call your partner in before you begin.
Prepare properly first: body armor and sticky bombs from Ammu-Nation, plus healing items.
Rob 3 shops back-to-back (green icons on the map) while still wanted — you must keep the flashing red/blue wanted level alive the whole chain; if it fades into the heat zone, the chain breaks.
A good route is the three jewelry stores in the north of Vice City, which open after Chapter 3's Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs and sit close together.
The unlock is delayed by roughly 30 seconds after the third shop; if it still has not popped, rob a fourth shop and keep going.

trophies.guide: Chain three shop robberies with your partner while the police chase never lets up. Steps: 1) Pair up after Chapter 2's Coffee Break and call your partner in. 2) Prepare with body armor, sticky bombs and healing items. 3) Rob 3 shops back-to-back while keeping the flashing wanted level alive. 4) The three north Vice City jewelry stores (after Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs) make a tight route. 5) The pop is delayed ~30 seconds; rob a fourth shop if it does not come.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.summary: Discover 100 different vehicles — scanning them with the WAiNK app counts, so you never have to drive a single one.

steps.text: Discover 100 different vehicles; scanning a vehicle with the WAiNK app counts as discovering it, and you do not need to drive it.
Open WAiNK by holding Up, look at a vehicle and hold R1 to scan it.
The fastest method is to stand at a busy road and scan passing traffic; boats and aircraft count as well.
Track your discoveries under Touch Pad > Progress > Vehicles, where scrolling over each category shows the totals found.
The 100% checklist wants 200 of the 277 base models, so start scanning early in the story and this trophy arrives on its own.

trophies.guide: Discover 100 different vehicles — scanning them with the WAiNK app counts, so you never have to drive a single one. Steps: 1) Scan vehicles with WAiNK (hold Up, then hold R1) to discover them; driving is not required. 2) Stand at a busy road and scan passing traffic; boats and aircraft count too. 3) Track discoveries under Touch Pad > Progress > Vehicles. 4) The 100% checklist wants 200 of 277 base models, so scan from the start of the story.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.summary: Drop five enemies inside one few-seconds window of Combat Focus slow-motion.

steps.text: Combat Focus is activated with L3 + R3 while aiming a firearm: time slows and vulnerable spots are highlighted, while the purple focus bar drains.
Fill your Focus before you start — eat, drink or wash up at home — and use Adrenaline to make the window last longer.
Line up 5 enemies and drop them all inside the single activation; an assault rifle's accuracy and full-auto fire make it far easier than a pistol.
Use gang members at illegal operations as the targets — the trophy does not seem to work on police, soldiers or civilians.
Your Focus level rises (up to level 4) through Shooting Range challenges, golf, pool, fishing and headshots, so this gets easier the later you try it.

trophies.guide: Drop five enemies inside one few-seconds window of Combat Focus slow-motion. Steps: 1) Activate Combat Focus with L3 + R3 while aiming. 2) Fill Focus first (food, drink, washing up); Adrenaline extends it. 3) Drop 5 enemies in the single activation, ideally with an assault rifle. 4) Target gang members at illegal operations — police, soldiers and civilians do not seem to count. 5) Focus level (up to 4) grows via ranges, golf, pool, fishing and headshots, so it gets easier later.

counter.label: Enemies down in one Combat Focus

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.summary: Steal a passenger jet straight off a departure gate at Vice City International Airport and fly it out of there.

steps.text: At VCIA, steal one of the large passenger planes docked at a departure terminal's boarding bridge — planes parked out on the airfield do not count.
The easiest is the plane at terminals E3/E4: drive through the airfield fence and enter by the stairs and door right beside the boarding bridge.
Go up into the cockpit, back the plane out toward the airstrip and take off.
Fly about 1 km away from the airport; the unlock is delayed until you are properly clear.
Save first — the police response at the airport comes fast.

trophies.guide: Steal a passenger jet straight off a departure gate at Vice City International Airport and fly it out of there. Steps: 1) Take a large passenger plane docked at a boarding bridge; airfield planes do not count. 2) The E3/E4 plane is easiest — in through the fence, up the stairs by the bridge. 3) Back it out from the cockpit and take off. 4) Fly about 1 km clear; the unlock is delayed. 5) Save first — the police come fast.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.summary: The cryptic description means exactly what it hints: get into a military Rhino tank and use it.

steps.text: Head to Mile Zero Air Station, the island at the south-west edge of the map in Mariana County — OutputLag places it on Goose Key at the bottom of the Keys.
The tanks stand at the south of the air base; get in through the gate or use the stunt jump next to the south-east entrance.
Enter a Rhino and shoot enemies from inside it until the trophy unlocks.

trophies.guide: The cryptic description means exactly what it hints: get into a military Rhino tank and use it. Steps: 1) Go to Mile Zero Air Station, the island at the south-west of the map in Mariana County. 2) The tanks are at the south of the base; enter via the gate or the stunt jump by the south-east entrance. 3) Shoot enemies from inside the Rhino until it pops.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.summary: Ghost a jewelry store: in through the back door with the Snap Gun, safe emptied, out again, never seen.

steps.text: First finish Chapter 3's Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs — it gives you the Snap Gun and unlocks jewelry store robberies, which appear as green icons on the map.
Enter through the locked back door using the Snap Gun; kicking the door in triggers the alarm and ruins the attempt.
In the back room, find the note carrying the safe code, loot the safe, and destroy the security footage and disable the alarm while you are there.
Richardson Jewelry & Diamonds in Vice City is a good target, and the trophy pops shortly after you leave the store undetected.
If someone does spot you, reload and run it again rather than fighting your way out.

trophies.guide: Ghost a jewelry store: in through the back door with the Snap Gun, safe emptied, out again, never seen. Steps: 1) Finish Chapter 3's Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs for the Snap Gun and the robbery unlock. 2) Enter via the back door with the Snap Gun — kicking it triggers the alarm. 3) Find the safe-code note in the back room, loot the safe, destroy the footage and disable the alarm. 4) Richardson Jewelry & Diamonds is a good target. 5) If you are spotted, reload and retry.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.summary: Crack five of the eight large bank vaults and get away clean — the best-paying crime on the list.

steps.text: Unlock vault robberies through the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is… — you rob the first vault as part of that mission.
Tail a security van until it stops at a bank and a guard carries a briefcase of cash inside and opens the vault; get in while the vault stands open.
Bring your partner: the haul is too much for one character to carry, so hand a bag off by holding Right on the D-pad.
Afterwards Yasmani sells security-van tips for $10,000 (once his earlier quests are done), marking the vans with a purple icon to follow.
Every vault robbery instantly brings a 4-star Wanted Level: escape on a fast motorcycle through traffic, then switch vehicles to become unrecognisable.
Any 5 of the 8 vaults earn the trophy, but 100% needs all 8 — and each vault pays up to $205,000, making this the best endgame income.

trophies.guide: Crack five of the eight large bank vaults and get away clean — the best-paying crime on the list. Steps: 1) Unlock vaults via the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is… 2) Tail a security van to its bank and enter the vault while it is open. 3) Bring your partner — the haul needs two carriers. 4) Yasmani sells van tips for $10,000, marking vans in purple. 5) Vaults bring an instant 4 stars: escape on a fast bike, then switch vehicles. 6) Any 5 of 8 vaults earn the trophy; 100% needs all 8, at up to $205,000 each.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.summary: Rob an armored truck and escape — in practice, the bank vault jobs do this for you.

steps.text: The Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is… unlocks this as well: robbing a large bank's vault counts as robbing an armored truck.
Tail the truck to the bank, enter the vault while it is open, take all the cash and escape the red heat radius — or duck into a Pay 'n' Spray.
There is an earlier free-roam method: block an armored truck driving near a bank, plant a sticky bomb on its back doors and blow them open.
Sticky bombs can be picked up in the back of Yasmani's shop after his Chapter 3 quests.
Either way the trophy only pops once you have escaped, and all 8 bank jobs are needed for 100% regardless.

trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape — in practice, the bank vault jobs do this for you. Steps: 1) Vault robberies from That's Where The Money Is… count as armored truck robberies. 2) Tail the truck, enter the open vault, take the cash and escape the heat (or use a Pay 'n' Spray). 3) Earlier method: block a truck, sticky-bomb its back doors. 4) Sticky bombs are in the back of Yasmani's shop after his quests. 5) It pops only once you have escaped.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.summary: Clear the fog from the entire map of Leonida — every last dark patch of the state.

steps.text: Fully unfog the whole map: every area still under black fog has to be visited or overflown until the entire map is visible.
The quickest way is by plane — fly over each remaining fogged patch until nothing dark is left.
PlayStation tracks the exploration across 52 areas of Leonida, the count carried in the official list data.

trophies.guide: Clear the fog from the entire map of Leonida — every last dark patch of the state. Steps: 1) Unfog the whole map by visiting or overflying every dark patch. 2) A plane is the quickest way to mop up what is left. 3) Exploration is tracked across 52 areas of Leonida.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.summary: Hit every one of Leonida's nine gangs where it hurts: rob at least one illegal operation from each of them.

steps.text: Rob one Illegal Operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs.
Operations are marked with yellow icons when you go near them, and many are also marked automatically as the story progresses.
Track your per-gang progress under Progress > Gangs — scrolling over a gang shows how many of its operations you have robbed.
There are 39 operations in total and the 100% checklist requires all of them, so this trophy arrives on the way.

trophies.guide: Hit every one of Leonida's nine gangs where it hurts: rob at least one illegal operation from each of them. Steps: 1) Rob one operation per gang, all 9 gangs. 2) Operations show as yellow icons when you are near, and many are marked by the story. 3) Track per-gang progress under Progress > Gangs. 4) All 39 operations are needed for 100%, so this arrives on the way.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.summary: A quiet one: a cocktail, a rooftop, and the Ocean Beach view the game opens with.

steps.text: Go to the Ocean View Rooftop Bar on Ocean Beach and buy an Apple Martini.
Drink it while standing next to the bar, and the trophy unlocks.
Be aware the lists are not unanimous: GTA-Zone still flags the exact trigger as unconfirmed, while the rooftop-bar method above is the one PowerPyx publishes.

trophies.guide: A quiet one: a cocktail, a rooftop, and the Ocean Beach view the game opens with. Steps: 1) Go to the Ocean View Rooftop Bar on Ocean Beach and buy an Apple Martini. 2) Drink it standing next to the bar. 3) GTA-Zone still flags the exact trigger as unconfirmed; the method above is PowerPyx's published route.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.summary: Steal one very specific blue Banshee from one very specific showroom — and leave through the window, in a nod to GTA III.

steps.text: You need the Key Cloner first, earned in the Chapter 3 mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS.
Go to the vehicle showroom in the south of Vice City and find the blue Banshee inside it.
Hack into the car with the Key Cloner, then drive it straight out through the showroom's window.
Keep driving away down the street — the unlock is slightly delayed and pops once you are further out.
Only that specific blue Banshee counts, not any other car: it is an easter egg reference to the Banshee from GTA III.

trophies.guide: Steal one very specific blue Banshee from one very specific showroom — and leave through the window, in a nod to GTA III. Steps: 1) Get the Key Cloner from Chapter 3's Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS. 2) Find the blue Banshee in the showroom in the south of Vice City. 3) Hack in with the Key Cloner and drive straight out through the window. 4) Keep driving; the unlock is slightly delayed. 5) Only that blue Banshee counts.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.summary: Rob the Kingpin Bowling gang operation in Port Gellhorn and take its three key valuables.

steps.text: The target is Kingpin Bowling in Port Gellhorn, a gang operation first marked by the Chapter 2 optional mission Hit Kingpin Bowling.
Buy sticky bombs at an Ammu-Nation before you go — you will need them for the safe.

Inside, take all three key valuables: the luxury watch in the south-east office, the unique Gutterball Moreland 850 shotgun on the table in the north-east corner, and the safe in the north-east hallway, blown open with sticky bombs.
The trophy unlocks after you escape the police, not when you pick up the third item, and clearing out the enemies inside is not required.
Missed one? The robbery icon respawns after a long wait and you can return for the rest — the valuables do not all have to be taken in a single visit, so this is not missable.

trophies.guide: Rob the Kingpin Bowling gang operation in Port Gellhorn and take its three key valuables. Steps: 1) It is first marked by the Chapter 2 optional mission Hit Kingpin Bowling. 2) Bring sticky bombs for the safe. 3) Take the luxury watch (south-east office), the Gutterball Moreland 850 shotgun (north-east table) and the safe (north-east hallway). 4) The trophy pops after you escape the police. 5) You can return later for anything missed — it is not missable.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.summary: The vague description decodes to a gym trophy: maximum Strength for Jason and Lucia at the same time.

steps.text: The description means maximum Strength with both characters at once — check the stat under Touch Pad > Jason & Lucia > Strength (the heart icon).
Start after Chapter 2's Coffee Break, when you can switch between the two characters freely.

Work out at fitness clubs (filter the map by Activities, the dumbbell icon) and always bring your partner along: while you train one character, the other trains automatically, so you make double progress.
A gym membership keeps it regular, and after the story you can also work out at home.

trophies.guide: The vague description decodes to a gym trophy: maximum Strength for Jason and Lucia at the same time. Steps: 1) Max out Strength for both (check it under Touch Pad > Jason & Lucia > Strength). 2) Start after Chapter 2's Coffee Break. 3) Train at fitness clubs with your partner along — the partner trains automatically, doubling progress. 4) After the story you can also work out at home.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.summary: Perform 500 actions that move your Criminal Profile — a counter that quietly fills up across the whole run.

steps.text: Perform 500 actions that affect your Criminal Profile; you can check the running count by opening the trophy in your trophy list.
Turn on the feedback so you can see it working: Settings > UI > HUD Notifications > Criminal Profile — a small face icon appears at the side of the screen whenever an action registers.

What moves it: stealthy objectives, destroyed evidence and clean escapes push you Professional; incapacitating enemies is Hardened; killing is Violent; killing large numbers of police and civilians is Psycho.
Avoid drifting into the Irredeemable profile: it is permanent, and police will shoot on sight far more readily.
Every robbery and enemy encounter feeds the count, so it fills passively while you work through the rest of the list — no dedicated grind needed.

trophies.guide: Perform 500 actions that move your Criminal Profile — a counter that quietly fills up across the whole run. Steps: 1) Reach 500 profile-changing actions; check the count in your trophy list. 2) Turn on Criminal Profile notifications (Settings > UI > HUD Notifications) to watch it register. 3) Stealth and clean escapes read Professional; incapacitating is Hardened; killing is Violent; mass killing is Psycho. 4) Avoid the permanent Irredeemable profile. 5) Robberies and fights feed it passively, so no dedicated grind is needed.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.summary: The one trophy nobody has cracked yet — we say so plainly, and give you the best current lead rather than a made-up method.

steps.text: Honest status first: no source has confirmed this trigger. PowerPyx lists it as currently unknown, and KeenGamer and GTAScoop also mark it unconfirmed.
The best current lead is PowerPyx's belief that it ties to the Payday Loans store from the Prologue, in Little Cuba, Vice City — possibly robbing it again later in a specific way.
The description itself, 'Second time's the charm', points at succeeding at something on a second attempt.
Practical cover: rotate manual saves as you play, so if a one-off event goes wrong the first time you can reload and take the second attempt deliberately.

trophies.guide: The one trophy nobody has cracked yet — we say so plainly, and give you the best current lead rather than a made-up method. Steps: 1) No source has confirmed the trigger; PowerPyx, KeenGamer and GTAScoop all mark it unconfirmed. 2) The best lead ties it to the Prologue's Payday Loans store in Little Cuba, possibly robbing it again in a specific way. 3) The description suggests succeeding at something on a second attempt. 4) Rotate manual saves so a failed first attempt can be reloaded and retried deliberately.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.summary: Trigger the UFO easter egg: a strange blinking car on a Kelly County road after 2 AM, and a woman to walk back through the dark.

steps.text: Head at night, after 2 AM, to the road north-west of the Starlet Motel in Kelly County — and come solo, without your partner.
Look for a car whose headlights are blinking on and off; if it is not there, the spawn is random — drive away and return later.
Approach the car and a set path leads you on foot to the UFO encounter.
Afterwards, walk the abducted woman back to her car, and the trophy unlocks.
Be aware this is PowerPyx's full route while other lists still mark the trophy unconfirmed — treat the method as the best documented lead, not gospel.

trophies.guide: Trigger the UFO easter egg: a strange blinking car on a Kelly County road after 2 AM, and a woman to walk back through the dark. Steps: 1) Go solo at night, after 2 AM, to the road north-west of the Starlet Motel in Kelly County. 2) Find the car with blinking headlights; if absent, drive away and return (the spawn is random). 3) Follow the path it starts to the UFO encounter. 4) Walk the abducted woman back to her car. 5) Other lists still mark this trophy unconfirmed; this is the best documented route.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.summary: Kick ten pedestrians off a moving bike, all inside a single minute.

steps.text: Ride any motorbike — your character's leg is the melee weapon here.
Kick pedestrians with the Square button as you ride past them.
All 10 kicks have to land within a 60-second window.
Use crowded pavements — Vice City and Ocean Beach are the densest hunting grounds.
KeenGamer and eGamers still list the precise method as unconfirmed; the bike-kick method above is the route PowerPyx documents.

trophies.guide: Kick ten pedestrians off a moving bike, all inside a single minute. Steps: 1) Ride any motorbike. 2) Kick pedestrians with Square as you pass. 3) Land all 10 within 60 seconds. 4) Work crowded pavements in Vice City or Ocean Beach. 5) KeenGamer and eGamers still call the method unconfirmed; this is PowerPyx's documented route.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.summary: Launder a quarter of a million dollars of marked bills through your fences — a long money grind that starts with the Dye Pack Jammer.

steps.text: First unlock the Dye Pack Jammer, gained during the Chapter 3 mission Credit Check.
Rob banks and Payday Loans stores to collect Marked Bills; the Jammer is what lets you keep them.
Deliver the marked bills to a fence to launder them; Yasmani pays the most for them.
Repeat until your cumulative laundered total reaches $250,000.
It is a long cumulative grind — fold it into your robbery routes rather than chasing it in one sitting.

trophies.guide: Launder a quarter of a million dollars of marked bills through your fences — a long money grind that starts with the Dye Pack Jammer. Steps: 1) Get the Dye Pack Jammer in Chapter 3's Credit Check. 2) Rob banks and Payday Loans stores for Marked Bills. 3) Launder them through a fence — Yasmani pays the most. 4) Repeat to a cumulative $250,000. 5) Fold it into your robbery routes; it is a long grind.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.summary: Spend $100,000 in total across the game's shops — weapons and car mods burn through it fastest.

steps.text: Spend a cumulative $100,000 across all shops; find every shop under Touch Pad > Style.
The fastest burn is guns, gun mods and tattoos.
The money sink is enormous: 24 Ammu-Nations, 19 Pay 'n' Sprays, 14 Mod Shops and 67 clothing stores — spread the spending wherever you are.
Fund it with the robbery economy: bank vaults pay up to $205,000 each, and Randy's and Kenton's questlines pay steady cash on the side.

trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 in total across the game's shops — weapons and car mods burn through it fastest. Steps: 1) Spend a cumulative $100,000; shops are listed under Touch Pad > Style. 2) Guns, gun mods and tattoos burn fastest. 3) There are 24 Ammu-Nations, 19 Pay 'n' Sprays, 14 Mod Shops and 67 clothing stores to spread it over. 4) Fund it with vault robberies (up to $205,000 each) and questline pay.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.summary: Buy all eight purchasable garages in Vice City — $160,000 of prime parking.

steps.text: After the Chapter 2 mission Daily Driver, buy garages through the Vice City Real Estate app on your phone.
Only the 8 purchasable garages count — the 4 garages the story gives you do not count toward this trophy.
The full set costs $160,000 in total.
Push Square's price list runs from the cheapest, Mitchel Auto Center at $4,000, up to Atlantic Court Garage at $40,000 — buy cheap first if cash is tight.
The slots are not wasted: registered Scooter Bros cars are delivered to your garages, and On the Spot needs the space.

trophies.guide: Buy all eight purchasable garages in Vice City — $160,000 of prime parking. Steps: 1) After Chapter 2's Daily Driver, buy via the Vice City Real Estate app. 2) Only the 8 purchasable garages count; the 4 story garages do not. 3) The set costs $160,000 in total. 4) Prices run from $4,000 (Mitchel Auto Center) to $40,000 (Atlantic Court Garage). 5) The slots feed On the Spot: registered cars are delivered to your garages.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.summary: Register ten cars to the Scooter Bros app so they are delivered to you on demand — insurance for your favourite rides.

steps.text: The Scooter Bros app arrives in the Chapter 2 mission Moses: visit Moses in Port Gellhorn and open Respray > Register to register a car, which requires a free garage spot.
Start with cars that have no tracker (they cannot be driven away); from Chapter 3, standard trackers can be fitted at any Pay 'n' Spray so those cars register too.
Register cheap cars to keep the cost down — the registration fee is what matters, not the car's value.
Keep registering until 10 vehicles are on the app; registered cars are delivered to you whenever you request them.

trophies.guide: Register ten cars to the Scooter Bros app so they are delivered to you on demand — insurance for your favourite rides. Steps: 1) The app arrives in Chapter 2's Moses; register at Moses in Port Gellhorn via Respray > Register, with a free garage spot. 2) Tracker-less cars register first; from Chapter 3, fit standard trackers at any Pay 'n' Spray. 3) Register cheap cars to keep costs down. 4) Reach 10 registered vehicles.
